text.tspan: Secrets: where they come from, and where they can leak
sensitive = true hides it HERE only
State file: value stored in PLAIN TEXT
Never: secrets in .tf, in committed .tfvars, or as plain outputs. Leak points: Git, CI logs, plan files, state.
Best: Terraform never sees the secret at all (AWS generates it in Secrets Manager); next best: ephemeral / write-only.
